extName.description: Extension name, used as the popup document title.

syncing.description: Loading indicator shown in the card grid while state loads.

loading.description: Placeholder title of the hover preview before room info arrives.

settingsTitle.description: Settings panel header and settings button tooltip.

columnGapX.description: Appearance slider label for the horizontal grid gap.

rowGapY.description: Appearance slider label for the vertical grid gap.

cardPaddingX.description: Appearance slider label for horizontal card padding.

cardPaddingY.description: Appearance slider label for vertical card padding.

textSize.description: Appearance slider label for the base font size.

cardBackground.description: Toggle label for showing the streamer card background.

resetToDefaults.description: Button that resets all appearance settings.

refreshInterval.description: Label of the refresh interval input, in seconds.

previewMode.description: Label of the hover preview mode selector.

previewThumbnail.description: Preview mode option: show the stream cover thumbnail.

previewLive.description: Preview mode option: embed the live player.

previewSound.description: Toggle label for enabling sound in the live preview.

customRooms.description: Custom rooms accordion header in settings.

addRoom.description: Label and tooltip of the add-room button in the custom rooms accordion.

addRoomPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the add-room input in the custom rooms accordion.

refreshData.description: Manual refresh button label and tooltip.

refreshing.description: Manual refresh button label while a refresh is running.

hiddenList.description: Button opening the hidden streamers panel.

exportSettings.description: Tooltip of the export settings button.

importSettings.description: Tooltip of the import settings button.

favorite.description: Context menu action: mark the streamer as favorite.

like.description: Context menu action: mark the streamer as liked.

hide.description: Context menu action: hide the streamer from the grid.

remove.description: Tooltip of the custom room remove button.

dismiss.description: Tooltip of the error banner close button.

listEmpty.description: Empty state of the hidden streamers list.

unknown.description: Fallback streamer name in the hidden list when info is missing.

previewError.description: Placeholder shown in the hover preview when the room info request fails.

errorAuth.message: Bilibili login expired. Please log in to bilibili.com again — monitoring is paused.
errorAuth.description: Error banner text for an expired bilibili session.

errorRisk.message: Temporarily rate-limited by bilibili. Monitoring will resume automatically.
errorRisk.description: Error banner text for bilibili risk-control rate limiting.

errorNetwork.message: Network error. Monitoring will retry automatically.
errorNetwork.description: Error banner text for generic network failures.

liveFor.description: Elapsed live time in the hover preview. $1 = hours, $2 = minutes.

medalLevel.description: Medal caption on a streamer card. $1 = medal name, $2 = medal level.

addRoomInvalid.description: Add-room status when the input cannot be parsed.

addRoomDuplicateCustom.description: Add-room status when the room is already a custom entry.

addRoomDuplicateMain.description: Add-room status when the streamer is already covered by the monitor mode list.

addRoomFetching.description: Add-room status while the room info request is in flight.

roomFallbackName.description: Fallback display name for a room whose master info is unavailable. $1 = room id.

importInvalid.description: Alert shown when a settings import fails.

notificationTitle.description: Browser notification title when a streamer goes live. $1 = streamer name.

alertScope.description: Settings section title for the alert-source matrix.

channelBadge.description: Matrix column header: the toolbar badge counter.

sourceMedal.description: Alert source row: streamers on the user's medal wall.

sourceCustom.description: Alert source row: manually added rooms.

sourceRest.description: Alert source row: every other followed streamer.

sourceRestHint.message: Needs following pagination — about 5 more requests per cycle.
sourceRestHint.description: Cost warning under the 'other following' row.

sourceExclusiveHint.message: Each streamer counts in one row only; the first matching row wins.
sourceExclusiveHint.description: Explains that the source buckets are mutually exclusive.

scopeTallyBadge.description: Badge tally pill. $1 = number of streamers in scope.

scopeTallyBadgeOff.description: Badge tally pill when no source is checked.

scopeTallyNotify.description: Notify tally pill. $1 = number of streamers in scope.

scopeTallyNotifyOff.description: Notify tally pill when no source is checked.

scopeCost.description: Request-cost readout. $1 = requests per refresh cycle.

scopeCostApprox.description: Request-cost readout when following pagination is on. $1 = approximate requests.

scopeUnionHint.message: The Alert scope view shows the union of both columns — $1 right now.
scopeUnionHint.description: Explains that the Alert scope view is the union of both columns. $1 = count.

scopeSeedHint.message: The first cycle after install, after changing these sources, and after a rate-limit pause only syncs state — no alerts are sent.

viewTooltip.description: Display-mode button tooltip. $1 = mode name, $2 = live count.

noStreamersInView.message: Nobody in this view right now.
noStreamersInView.description: Empty state when the chosen display mode has no streamers.

loadingFollowing.description: Shown while the on-demand following snapshot loads.

notificationMore.description: Collapsed notification for streamers past the per-cycle cap. $1 = how many more.
